inv.desc_en:
400 m² premises to shape your next project near the Quintana metro station in Madrid.
Just a few meters from Calle Alcalá, very close to its commercial area, this space combines location, spaciousness, and a facade with great potential to give visibility to your business.
20 meters of facade and 20 meters of depth: a large space to plan the layout your activity needs. It does not have a smoke vent.
An opportunity for those looking for a space to develop their project or a commercial investment in the Quintana neighborhood.
Sale price: €995,000
Do you want to see it and evaluate its possibilities? Call Felipe at 644 386 588 and arrange your visit.
